Going on a Trip 63
Lesson 1: At the Airport
Keywords: lounge, immigration

1. What do you see?
2. Can you guess where it could be?
3. Who are the people in the picture?
4. What could be their relationship?
B. Now read the text and find out if your guesses are correct:
Zara lives with her parents in London. They have come to Bangladesh to visit
Zara’s aunt and uncle. She is very close to her cousin, Mita. Both the families
have visited many interesting places together in Bangladesh. It was great fun.
Then they decided that they would visit some places outside Bangladesh too.
They decided to go to Thailand. But Mita’s parents were too busy with their
work, so they could not go. However, Mita was going with them.
Mita, Zara and her parents are at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
They are waiting in the lounge. Mita is very excited. This is the first time
that she is travelling on a plane. They are flying by Bangladesh Biman.
Mita is hoping to have a great time in Thailand.
‘¢ As they wait, the two cousins start planning what they would do once they
reach Bangkok. Mita’s uncle brings forms for all of them to fill in before going
